{{Top|leg}}
'''The Code of the Stars''' was a system of ethics relating to the operation of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] which, by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], was considered to be old-fashioned. The code advocated the use of harsh methods of discipline, such as floggings and throwing crew members out of [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]], and it was intended as a means by which to keep starship crews disciplined, so as to prevent mutinies. The starship [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Kortho Hatanga]] was an ardent supporter of The Code of the Stars, and of the principles that were demonstrated in the code.
